body:
On Android the last-touched-by initials badge sits to the right of an item row,
snug against the edit pencil (the text column has weight(1f)). On web the text
column had no flex-grow, so with justify-content:space-between across the three
children the badge floated centered in the gap instead. Give the text column
flex:1 so the badge sits next to the pencil, matching Android.
title: Web item rows: right-align the author badge next to the edit pencil (match Android)
